default.description: Main window: IPC commands only. No fs/shell/http — file access lives in the Rust core. `allow-start-dragging` is the one window command added on top of core:default: the window uses titleBarStyle "Overlay"/hiddenTitle (tauri.conf.json), so there is no OS titlebar to grab and `data-tauri-drag-region` is the only way to move it — and that surface is inert without this permission.
